how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-tirisfal-glades-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

E46.en: The Lost Magic of the Runemasters

rows.quest:398:obj:0: Kill ⟦E1⟧ and return to ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E3⟧ with his paw for a reward.
rows.quest:398:details:1: BA foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, ⟦E1⟧ has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The ⟦E5⟧. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. ⟦E1⟧ was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:398:details:2: The town of ⟦E3⟧ hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show ⟦E2⟧ the villain's paw once the deed is done.
rows.quest:398:completion:0: ⟦E1⟧'s dastardly acts have finally been avenged. Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people. On behalf of the town of ⟦E3⟧ I thank you, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:445:details:0: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.
rows.quest:445:details:1: As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.
rows.quest:445:details:2: Take these findings to ⟦E7⟧ who is stationed at The Sepulcher in ⟦E8⟧. Follow the roads to the south from ⟦E3⟧. From the ⟦E9⟧ go southwest.
rows.quest:445:progress:0: What business do you have with me, ⟦2⟧?
rows.quest:445:completion:0: Ah, how good of ⟦E6⟧ to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and ⟦E10⟧. Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.
rows.quest:445:completion:1: But you must excuse my rambling. Extend your stay in Silverpine, ⟦3⟧. We could use an able bodied ⟦4⟧ like you around here.
rows.quest:354:details:0: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in ⟦E10⟧. I used to work their mills...before the Plague.
rows.quest:354:details:1: When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.
rows.quest:354:details:2: The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge!
rows.quest:354:details:3: Serve the ⟦E5⟧ by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.
rows.quest:354:progress:0: Do you have the remains of the Agamands? Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
rows.quest:354:completion:0: ⟦E15⟧ has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.
rows.quest:354:completion:1: It is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
rows.quest:356:obj:0: Kill 8 ⟦E17⟧ Horrors and 8 Wandering Spirits, then report back to Linnea at her camp.
rows.quest:356:details:0: The defenders on The Bulwark protecting Tirisfal from the ⟦E18⟧ are on constant alert. But sometimes Scourge will slip past them.
rows.quest:356:details:1: Our success at the Bulwark depends on a one-front battle - we cannot allow an attack from the rear, nor can we allow our defenders' supply line to be cut.
rows.quest:356:details:2: Assist the Bulwark. Patrol east and slay any Scourge you find. Spend particular effort at the Balnir Farmstead to the east. It has become a haven for interloping Scourge.
rows.quest:356:progress:0: Do you have a report of your patrol?
rows.quest:356:completion:0: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:369:obj:0: ⟦E6⟧ in the town of ⟦E3⟧ wants you to bring him 4 samples of venom from a ⟦E20⟧.
rows.quest:369:details:0: While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims. Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.
rows.quest:369:details:1: Bring me some venom from a ⟦E20⟧ to complete this experiment. I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction. Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:369:progress:0: Do you have some venom from a ⟦E20⟧ yet, ⟦5⟧? It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
rows.quest:369:completion:0: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, ⟦6⟧. Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down. Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
rows.quest:492:details:0: According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured. The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.
rows.quest:492:details:1: Why don't you go see how the ⟦E22⟧ enjoys this special drink I made for him? It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of ⟦E23⟧.
rows.quest:492:progress:0: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, ⟦7⟧.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
rows.quest:492:completion:0: Ah, a drink at last. I'm sure it's no ⟦E24⟧ but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
rows.quest:372:obj:0: ⟦E2⟧ in the town of ⟦E3⟧ wants you to assassinate ⟦E25⟧ and his two bodyguards.
rows.quest:372:details:0: ⟦E26⟧ Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest. According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named ⟦E25⟧ is in charge of this evil crew.
rows.quest:372:details:1: I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission. Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
rows.quest:372:progress:0: You have not yet performed your duty, ⟦8⟧.  We cannot expect to carry out The Dark Lady's plan with the ⟦E27⟧ pestering our soldiers.  Bring about their deaths and perform your duty to Sylvanas!
rows.quest:372:completion:0: You have done extremely well, ⟦9⟧. With ruthless fighters like you conquering in the name of The ⟦E5⟧ our race is one step closer to defeating ⟦E28⟧ once and for all. I have a good feeling about you, comrade.
rows.quest:409:obj:2: Return to Gunther on his island.
rows.quest:409:details:0: You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this. But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge.
rows.quest:409:details:1: There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:409:details:2: Take a ⟦E29⟧ from this crate here. Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
rows.quest:409:progress:0: I await proof of your allegiance, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:409:completion:0: You have defeated ⟦E30⟧, proving you are an enemy of the Scourge. Incredible.
rows.quest:409:completion:1: I had believed I was the only Undead with free will, but you have shown me there are others who have broken the Lich King's domination.
rows.quest:411:details:0: Take this ⟦E33⟧ to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
rows.quest:411:progress:0: Have you returned Gunther's book? Has he responded?
rows.quest:411:completion:0: You convinced him to join us! You have done a great deed for the ⟦E5⟧, ⟦11⟧. The Dark Lady will be informed.
rows.quest:96895:title: The Argent Emissary
rows.quest:96895:obj:0: Find the Argent Dawn member near the entrance to the ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:96895:details:0: Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both ⟦E5⟧... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.
rows.quest:96895:details:1: One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
rows.quest:96897:title: The Cult of the Damned
rows.quest:96897:obj:0: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in .
rows.quest:96897:details:0: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the ⟦E27⟧. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
rows.quest:96897:progress:0: I have a special disgust for living servants of the scourge. They have the free will to walk away, yet the promise of power and immortality has robbed them of their reason and their morality.
rows.quest:96898:title: Remnants of War
rows.quest:96898:details:0: It wasn't long ago that the citadel of ⟦E37⟧ bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the ⟦E5⟧ off the map. Both the ⟦E5⟧ and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:96898:details:1: During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath ⟦E37⟧ was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the scourge of them.
rows.quest:96898:progress:0: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
rows.quest:96899:title: Bandarion Keep
rows.quest:96899:details:0: You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.
rows.quest:96899:details:1: If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
rows.quest:408:obj:0: Kill 8 Wailing Ancestors and 8 Rotting Ancestors.
rows.quest:408:obj:1: Kill Captain Dargol, and bring his skull to ⟦E39⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:408:details:0: The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge. Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered. With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.
rows.quest:408:details:1: This cannot pass, and you must stop it. ⟦E40⟧ to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.
rows.quest:408:details:2: And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
rows.quest:408:progress:0: Time is not a luxury we have, ⟦12⟧. With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on ⟦E10⟧ grows more firm.
rows.quest:408:completion:0: Your actions struck a telling blow against the Scourge. And your victory will not go unnoticed - not by the ⟦E5⟧, nor by our enemies.
rows.quest:408:completion:1: Continue the struggle as we all do, ⟦13⟧, and one day we will drive the Lich King himself from ⟦E23⟧!
rows.quest:92422:title: The ⟦E42⟧ of Rath'mael
rows.quest:92422:obj:0: Kill Rath'mael in the  for ⟦E43⟧ in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:92422:details:0: Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth.
rows.quest:92422:details:1: Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, ⟦14⟧.
rows.quest:92422:details:2: If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the ⟦E5⟧. Drive this creature out of our lands.
rows.quest:92422:progress:0: Has the skeletal lieutenant been slain?
rows.quest:92422:completion:0: While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.
rows.quest:96800:title: Past Due
rows.quest:5901:obj:0: Use the ⟦E49⟧ on the Termite Mounds in ⟦E50⟧. After you've gathered 100 ⟦E51⟧, return to ⟦E52⟧ at the Bulwark in ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:5901:details:0: So, to bring pain and strife to the ⟦E27⟧, I want to take their precious lumber mill from them. I'm sure the loss of such a resource will cause them a great deal of harm in defending and rebuilding the town for their own reasons. Will you help me, ⟦16⟧?
rows.quest:5901:details:1: Start by taking this jar to Plaguewood in the ⟦E50⟧. Fill it with the termites you find in their mounds throughout the woods. Come back when you have enough.
rows.quest:5901:progress:0: Do you have the termites yet, ⟦17⟧? I am sure it is obvious to a smart ⟦18⟧ like yourself.⟦19⟧⟦20⟧Once we have enough of them, we'll make sure no one can use the lumber mill ever again!
rows.quest:5901:completion:0: These will do nicely, ⟦21⟧. Thank you.
rows.quest:5901:completion:1: If you're ready, we can get on with the next step.
rows.quest:5902:obj:0: Find someplace suitable in the center of the Northridge Lumber Mill in ⟦E53⟧ to place the ⟦E54⟧.
rows.quest:5902:details:0: Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town.
rows.quest:5902:details:1: Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something.
rows.quest:5902:details:2: After you open it, the rest should take care of itself. Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.
rows.quest:5902:completion:0: The termites are obviously getting restless as you place the barrel on top of the crate.
